name: deploy_status
description: Query the status of a deployment unit in z-ops. Use this when the CEO agent (or human) needs to check if a deploy finished, or to see error logs on failure. Returns the current status (pending/running/succeeded/failed/rolled_back), progress percentage, start/finish timestamps, and any error messages. Backed by GET /api/ops/deployment/{id} and GET /api/ops/record/list (for historical records).

includeRecords.description: If true, also return historical records for this deployment (succeeded/failed attempts). Default false.
